title: Why “Australian AIs only” is harder than it sounds
gist: Cory Alpert argues that Deputy PM Richard Marles' pitch for Anthropic to make Australia a 'second home' does not by itself deliver sovereign AI, because frontier models are continuously superseded and fine-tuning converts classified data into capability that information-security markings like AUSTEO cannot govern. Sovereignty must be defined over the capability pipeline, not data-centre location, via access across model generations, rights to models trained on Australian data, and evaluation capacity.
